claims.text: The general was a correspondent, not only a subject. The 'DeLonge/Podesta Meeting' thread of 24 and 25 January 2016 runs between Podesta and neilmcc79@gmail.com, who signs 'Neil McC' and whom the Google calendar invitation names as Neil McCasland, copied to t.delonge@me.com, mfisher@hillaryclinton.com, rob.f.weiss@lmco.com and carey.mjd@gmail.com. Podesta organised the meeting as a Google Hangout and moved it to 12:30 Eastern after a blizzard.
